statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is low while broad market Stress remains extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON because Tail is below 20%; Stress remains extreme around the U.S. event cluster and geopolitical risk.
headline: Low Tail, extreme Stress ahead of the U.S. event cluster
body: Fresh delayed NQ is modestly positive after trading both below and above its open, while Treasury yields have eased and broader futures are slightly firmer. No current evidence verifies persistent no-retracement NQ structure. Oil remains near $95 Brent amid U.S.-Iran/Hormuz risk, with major U.S. releases beginning at 12:30 UTC.

lookbackSummary: Published history shows elevated Tail during parts of the prior U.S. session, then a steady transition to low-Tail mixed structure overnight. The 22:00 UTC slot has no published assessment and remains unavailable.
outlookSummary: Tail stays below the blocking threshold in the base forecast, peaking at 24% around the U.S. release and cash-open window. Any higher Tail state remains conditional on subsequently observed persistent NQ extension and poor retracement quality.

forecast.analysis: Delayed NQ is +0.13% after trading both sides of its open and remains off session extremes. Two-way structure keeps Tail low; oil, geopolitics and the U.S. event cluster keep Stress extreme.
drivers: Two-way NQ range; price off extremes
12:30 UTC U.S. data/Fed cluster; oil/Hormuz risk

forecast.analysis: If the Europe-to-U.S. handoff stays two-sided, Tail remains low. Stress rises as the 12:30 UTC data/Waller cluster approaches.
Pre-release liquidity can amplify whipsaw. Tail rises modestly unless NQ starts holding an extreme with shallow or failed pullbacks.
drivers: Extreme-holding or failed pullbacks would raise Tail

forecast.analysis: The 12:30 UTC trade, claims, productivity and Waller cluster is the first danger peak. WATCH depends on post-release path quality.
Post-data trading overlaps the cash-open approach. WATCH persists conditionally if the first move repeatedly extends with weak retracements.
ISM Services at 14:00 UTC extends the danger window. WATCH remains conditional on persistent extension and failed mean reversion.
After the main releases, Tail should ease if retracements return and yields, oil and volatility stabilize.
By 16:00 UTC the main release window is scheduled to be past. Two-sided rotation would return Tail below WATCH.
drivers: Scheduled main release window is past by this slot

forecast.analysis: Tail keeps easing if cash-session pullbacks deepen. Geopolitical and rate uncertainty can keep Stress high without a Tail escalation.
drivers: Oil and rates remain Stress drivers

forecast.analysis: Late-afternoon Tail stays low unless a fresh one-way move gains confirmation from rates, volatility or technology leadership.
Hammack's scheduled 19:00 UTC remarks add a policy checkpoint. Tail stays below WATCH unless headlines align with persistent NQ extension.
drivers: Persistent NQ extension required for escalation

forecast.analysis: If the policy-headline window passes without sustained follow-through, Tail should recede while oil and rates keep Stress elevated.
Late-session Tail remains low if extension stalls and retracements stay available. Renewed pressure at session extremes would invalidate that path.
At the futures-session transition, thin liquidity may widen moves. A block state still requires repeated extension, not isolated volatility.
Early overnight Tail stays low if the U.S. close is orderly. Middle East headlines remain a Stress amplifier.
During the Asia handoff, the base case is normal two-sided discovery unless a new cross-asset shock creates directional persistence.
drivers: New cross-asset shock is the main escalation route

forecast.analysis: Overnight Tail remains low if liquidity normalizes and no new catalyst forces repeated extension. Friday payrolls keep background Stress elevated.
Large overnight moves would still need poor retracement quality and cross-asset confirmation before Tail materially rises.
As Asia trading matures, Tail remains low unless NQ holds an extreme through multiple failed pullbacks. Payroll anticipation mainly raises Stress.
Approaching Europe, event anticipation starts rebuilding Stress. Tail rises only slightly because payrolls remain hours away.
European liquidity may increase sensitivity to rates and the dollar. Tail stays low unless those moves align with persistent NQ extension.
Pre-payroll positioning lifts Stress. A widening, poorly retraced gap would be the first condition for higher Tail.
drivers: Poorly retraced gap would raise Tail

forecast.analysis: As U.S. premarket approaches, whipsaw risk rises. Tail stays below WATCH because the employment release is still ahead.
drivers: Pre-release conditions raise Stress more than Tail

forecast.analysis: Payroll anticipation strengthens, but the release remains outside this 24-hour forecast. Higher Tail requires a persistently one-way premarket path.
drivers: Premarket persistence required for higher Tail

forecastDetail.comment: Delayed NQ is two-sided and off its extremes; low Tail coexists with extreme event and geopolitical Stress.
Tail stays low if the Europe-to-U.S. handoff remains two-sided while the 12:30 UTC cluster approaches.
Pre-release whipsaw rises, but higher Tail still requires persistent extension and weak pullbacks.
The 12:30 UTC cluster is the first danger peak; WATCH depends on post-release path quality.
Post-data trading overlaps the cash-open approach; repeated extension would sustain WATCH.
ISM Services extends the danger window; failed retracements would be the escalation signal.
